scope: PERF-12.comparisons intake over the 22 existing traditional declarations, the complete Full43 suite, and the 15 protected required contracts. This is not complete PERF-12 or V1 acceptance.

comparison_policy.post_normalization_comparator: Exact Python container/scalar types and all keys/rows; finite floats use math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12).
comparison_policy.ordering: Group, top and rank outputs are canonicalized by the declared result normalizer; this alone cannot certify original SQL output ordering. A separate original-envelope replay checks 48 explicitly ordered statements.
comparison_policy.logical_types_and_nulls: Native original envelopes retain typed values. The independent baseline returns normalized values; this matrix does not infer logical-type or NULL fidelity from normalized equality.
comparison_policy.independence: Baseline processes compute their own results before native requests. Native rejection never invokes a comparison engine as fallback.

observed.interpretation: One isolated observation with unchanged standard runner and original input/reference; no causal or speedup claim.

full43.gap: The latest complete observation uses retained native regression values, not an independent full-size oracle or paired performance comparison.
full43.required_action: Keep the accepted regression observation. Before a comparative claim, pin a genuinely independent supported equivalent, complete semantics/data/build/cache/resources and paired uncertainty under a separate frozen protocol.
full43.routine_execution_rule: Exactly one isolated execution per query; no rerun merely to present or reclassify existing evidence.

support_evidence.scope: Named Linux/macOS installed-native lanes and local macOS UAT; Windows wheel is CLI-backed with version/admission checks. No broad Windows native-extension, pressure or full-workload parity claim.

scheduled_and_optional_boundary.next_stages: Required workload gaps and public guarantees precede the already requested region/local-reduction/cost/dispatch prerequisites, then their gated investigations. Optional breadth is not started automatically.
scheduled_and_optional_boundary.publication_authorization: No subsequent release train is authorized by this assessment.
